stories.title: Election Integrity or Voter Suppression? Supreme Court Lets Trump's Mail-Ballot Order Move Forward
stories.conservative_headline: SCOTUS Hands Trump a Win: Court Clears Path to Secure Mail Ballots Before Midterms
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Greenlights Trump's Mail Ballot Power Grab Weeks Before Voters Get Ballots
stories.poll_question: Should Trump's administration be able to impose new federal mail-ballot rules?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Uniform federal standards stop fraud and restore confidence in mail ballots.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Constitution gives states election authority; this invites chaos and disenfranchisement.

stories.title: Redistricting Justice or Judicial Sabotage? Missouri's GOP Map Blocked, Then Rushed to SCOTUS
stories.conservative_headline: Activist Judges Steal a Seat: Missouri Asks SCOTUS to Restore Legislature's Lawful Map
stories.liberal_headline: Missouri Court Blocks Mid-Decade Gerrymander — Now Republicans Want SCOTUS to Override It
stories.poll_question: Should Missouri's new GOP-drawn map be used in November?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Elected lawmakers draw maps; courts shouldn't rewrite them before an election.
stories.poll_option2_desc: A mid-decade partisan redraw violates state law and voters' rights.

stories.title: Deterrence or Escalation? US Strikes Iranian Oil Carriers After Attacks on Navy Warships
stories.conservative_headline: Peace Through Strength: Trump Hits Back Hard After Iran Attacks American Warships
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Escalates Iran Conflict With New Strikes — Where Is Congress on War Powers?
stories.poll_question: Were the retaliatory strikes on Iranian oil carriers the right call?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Attacks on US sailors demand swift retaliation to restore deterrence.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Unauthorized escalation risks a wider war Congress never voted for.

stories.title: Loyalty Screening or Purge by Polygraph? Pentagon Lie-Detector Tests on Senior Officials
stories.conservative_headline: Hegseth Cracks Down: Pentagon Uses Polygraphs to Root Out Damaging Leakers
stories.liberal_headline: Pentagon Straps Top Officials to Lie Detectors in Chilling Hunt for Leakers
stories.poll_question: Is polygraphing senior Pentagon officials to find leakers justified?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Leaks endanger troops and operations; aggressive vetting is common sense.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Junk-science intimidation used to punish dissent and silence whistleblowers.

stories.title: Ranchers' Rights or Wildlife Rollback? Trump Order Lets Herd Owners Kill Wolves
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Sides With Ranchers: New Order Lets Families Protect Livestock From Wolf Packs
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Signs Order Opening Season on Wolves, Gutting Decades of Species Protection
stories.poll_question: Should ranchers be allowed to kill wolves threatening their herds?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Ranchers deserve to defend livelihoods from predators without federal red tape.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Recovered wolf populations will collapse again under open-season killing.

stories.title: Energy Abundance or Arctic Giveaway? Interior Fast-Tracks Alaska Drilling as Diesel Hits Record
stories.conservative_headline: Drill Now: Trump Fast-Tracks Alaska Oil as Record Diesel Prices Punish Truckers
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Pays Off a Wind Developer to Kill Turbines While Rushing Arctic Drilling
stories.poll_question: Is fast-tracking Alaska oil drilling the right answer to high fuel prices?
stories.poll_option1_desc: More domestic supply lowers fuel costs and boosts energy independence.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Arctic drilling won't cut prices but will lock in decades of emissions.

stories.title: Accountability or Vendetta? Democrats Vow to Probe Trump's $4 Billion Net Worth Surge
stories.conservative_headline: Here We Go Again: Democrats Promise Endless Investigations Instead of Fixing Prices
stories.liberal_headline: Democrats Ready Subpoenas Over Trump's $4 Billion Windfall and His Sons' Deals
stories.poll_question: Should Congress investigate the growth of Trump's personal fortune in office?
stories.poll_option1_desc: A partisan fishing expedition designed to smear ahead of the midterms.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Presidents profiting off the office demands full congressional scrutiny.

stories.title: Law Enforcement or Voter Intimidation? DHS Says Agents May Enter Polling Places
stories.conservative_headline: DHS Chief: Federal Agents Will Respond to Threats and Warrants — Even at Polls
stories.liberal_headline: DHS Floats Sending Armed Agents Into Polling Places, Alarming Election Officials
stories.poll_question: Should federal immigration agents be allowed inside polling places?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Agents must respond to threats and valid warrants anywhere, including polls.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Agents at polling sites scare eligible voters away and taint elections.

stories.title: Ready to Serve or Readiness Risk? Trump Asks SCOTUS to Uphold Transgender Military Ban
stories.conservative_headline: Trump to SCOTUS: Restore Military Standards, Uphold the Transgender Service Ban
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Asks Supreme Court to Bless Purge of Transgender Americans From the Military
stories.poll_question: Should the military's transgender service ban be upheld?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Deployability and medical standards, not identity politics, must govern service.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Qualified volunteers are being fired for who they are, weakening the force.

stories.title: Innovation or Invasion? New Poll Shows Bipartisan Dread of AI as Washington Stalls
stories.conservative_headline: Voters Uneasy on AI — But Heavy-Handed Rules Would Hand the Future to China
stories.liberal_headline: Americans Across Party Lines Fear AI While Washington Lets Big Tech Write the Rules
stories.poll_question: How should Washington handle artificial intelligence?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Light-touch rules keep America ahead of China and grow the economy.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Strong federal guardrails needed now to protect jobs, privacy, and truth.
